message.content: {"rules":["Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is exact and cheap to call.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must not override TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size.","All subtypes and all supertypes of Self must also implement TrustedRandomAccess. In particular, implementations for types with non-invariant parameters generally cannot depend on trait bounds on those parameters, except bounds from the respective struct or enum definition or bounds involving traits with a similar guarantee.","If Self: ExactSizeIterator, self.len() must always produce results consistent with self.size().","If Self: Iterator, calling <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) requires 0 <= idx and idx < self.size().","If Self: Iterator + !Clone, __iterator_get_unchecked must not be called with the same index on self more than once. Calls on values obtained by coercing self to a supertype, including further coercion results, count toward the same limit.","After self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx) has been called, self.next_back() may be called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times. If Self: Clone and self is cloned, this limit is calculated separately for self and its clone, but next_back calls before cloning count for both. Calls on values obtained through supertype coercions, including further coercion results, are added together with calls on self and must not exceed the applicable limit.","After self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx) has been called, the only methods that may be called on self or any new clones of self are Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size. If self is subsequently coerced to a supertype T, the same method restriction applies to the resulting value, including through multiple coercion steps.","If Self: Iterator, __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) must be safe to call when the index bounds, non-Clone repeated-index restriction, next_back limits and clone accounting, post-call method restrictions, and cumulative accounting across supertype coercions are all satisfied.","Under those safe-call conditions, __iterator_get_unchecked must not change the value returned by size_hint.","Under those safe-call conditions, after __iterator_get_unchecked is called it must remain safe to call Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size on self, assuming the required traits are implemented and the applicable call restrictions continue to be met.","Under those safe-call conditions, it must be safe to drop self after calling self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx).","If Self is a subtype of T, self may safely be coerced to T, including after __iterator_get_unchecked has been called, provided the post-call method restrictions and cumulative call limits continue to be respected. Multiple such coercion steps are permitted."]}
